security_spec.violation_condition: The CSR write logic for mnstatus allows a CSR write instruction (CSRRW/CSRRS/CSRRC) with rs1 field configured to clear the NMIE bit to actually write 0 to mnstatus.NMIE. Spec mandates NMIE is set-only (writes of 0 have no effect). In XiangShan RTL, this would occur if the CSR module's write-masking logic for mnstatus unconditionally accepts the write data for the NMIE bit position without enforcing that the bit can only transition 0→1.
security_spec.summary: mnstatus.NMIE bit is spec-mandated as set-only (software can set to 1 but cannot clear to 0) — if CSR write logic permits clearing NMIE via CSRRW/CSRRS/CSRRC, software can mask non-maskable interrupts, defeating the hardware security guarantee that RNMI cannot be disabled by software
